comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Editor
themes.text: The editor can rename, find, import and generate code, and it has more quick fixes. It can also show what your program did for a recorded request.

themes.title: Web APIs
themes.text: The API document that Novis writes for your server passes a strict OpenAPI check. A parameter can read its value from the query string. A wrong value gives a `400` error.

themes.title: Testing
themes.text: `nvs test` gets the features a team expects, and tests stay out of your builds. `nvs test --mutate` checks if your tests notice a wrong line. Benchmarks report counted work that CI can check.

themes.title: Debugging and profiling
themes.text: A debugger stops your program at a line and shows its variables, in VS Code too. Novis records requests, and a viewer shows each one with its timeline, logs and errors. The profiler shows where the time goes.

themes.title: Images
themes.text: AVIF and JPEG XL images open the right way up and with the right colours. `Image::info` reads EXIF data, and an animated image keeps every frame.

themes.title: Packages and the registry
themes.text: `nvs` installs and locks the packages your program uses, and the registry builds every package from its source code. `nvs pkg audit` lists the known security problems in your packages, and the version that fixes each one.

themes.title: Passkeys and Web Push
themes.text: `Core\Passkey` lets a user sign in with a passkey. `Core\WebPush` sends a notification to a browser.
